visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a dimly lit backstage area of a large stadium. A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a light blue short-sleeved button-down shirt over a dark t-shirt, sits alone on a black chair next to stacks of cardboard boxes and two giant foam dice. He looks contemplative, his hands resting in his lap. Yellow text overlays appear at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to a brightly lit interior hallway with exposed pipes on the ceiling. The man is now walking toward the camera, which is held by someone else. He gestures with his hands toward his shirt and a pink ID badge hanging around his neck. A female hand with painted nails briefly enters the frame, pointing at him. He smiles slightly while talking. (3) The man points down a long corridor where many people are gathered in the distance. He turns his back to the camera, revealing the same blue shirt. In the background, posters for beauty products and various stadium signs are visible. (4) A quick montage shows a group of cheerleaders in white and red uniforms performing on a stage decorated with floral patterns and product logos. The man is then seen sitting alone again in the storage area, looking down at his phone. (5) The man is on the main stage with a host in a red and white baseball jersey and three cheerleaders. They participate in a group hand-stacking ceremony. The man looks slightly awkward but smiles for the cameras. Large product displays of 'Physiogel' and 'Euthymol' are prominent behind them. (6) The man interacts with fans, taking selfies using their smartphones. He shows a close-up of a photo in a pink ID holder. Finally, he is seen backstage again, attempting to talk to the cheerleaders before a graphic overlay promoting a beauty product event closes the video.

The male speaker's intensity increases as he jokes about his image. (4) The scene transitions to the event stage. The audio is dominated by the loud, projected voice of the host through a PA system, accompanied by enthusiastic cheering and rhythmic clapping from the crowd. (5) Several cartoon-style 'pop' and 'boing' sound effects are peppered through the interaction on stage, punctuating the comedic timing of the man's awkward movements.
